name: Imperial Silk (Royal Kimono Detail)
description: Royal 3D showcase of imperial court silk. A grand ceremonial kimono robe displayed on a black lacquer stand, crafted from deep royal crimson silk brocade and heavy spun gold thread, embroidered with soaring golden celestial dragons.
prompt: Masterwork 3D detailed concept art of royal imperial Japanese ceremonial silk robe. An exquisite kimono on a pitch-black lacquer display stand, made of deep crimson red (#FF2035) silk brocade heavily embroidered with magnificent golden dragons and clouds with black velvet accents. Pure pitch-black background (#000000), dramatic crimson red lantern lighting and floating gold specks, 8k quality, no text.
